title: MASM version discrimination by cross-assembly of admitted routines
method: Every admitted GAME_ASM recipe was re-searched under other pinned MASM versions with the same source and the version default flags; strict complete-member result recorded.
conclusion: The game assembly was built with MASM 6.x; 5.x is excluded. 6.00, 6.00B, 6.11 and 6.14 are not yet distinguished; 6.00/6.00B are the period-plausible releases. New assembly work defaults to masm600.
